title: City Fleet Refresh
pitch: The Transit Office is renewing its service fleet: parts built to drawing, cars sourced and delivery runs flown across the city.

parts.label: Deliver one OEM production order
parts.hint: Accept an RFQ, schedule the machines and deliver the batch.

parts.label: Sell three cars
parts.hint: Win at auction, recondition and sell, or sell new from the franchise.

parts.label: Complete five van runs
parts.hint: Accept runs in Company OS and plan each route.
